The '''Dandelo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dandelo]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Fuzzum]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Coby and the Starhunters" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dandelo system first appeared, albeit unidentified, in "[[Coby and the Starhunters]]," the ninth episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'',<ref name="Coby and the Starhunters" /> which originally aired on [[November 2]], [[1985]].<ref name="Coby and the Starhunters air date">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> It was later identified in [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], which placed the system in grid square T-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
